rationale: Brokerage/property-management services attach to local property and are mostly non-tradable, though commercial brokerage can serve buyers/investors from other regions and abroad -- mixed under both.

isic_name: Other professional, scientific and technical activities n.e.c.

Veterinary services are delivered on-site to local pet owners and farms (non-tradable Atlas), but livestock/animal-health practices serve a regional agricultural catchment (tradable regional). Divergence; mixed.

isic_name: Renting and leasing of motor vehicles
rationale: Vehicle rental serves travellers and regional business clients (airport rental partly serves inbound visitors), but is largely a domestic service; non-tradable Atlas (mixed), tradable regional. Divergence; mixed.

isic_name: Renting and leasing of recreational and sports goods
rationale: Consumer recreational/sports-goods rental serves local users (some tourist rental); non-tradable Atlas, mixed/leaning local regionally.

isic_name: Renting of video tapes and disks
rationale: Local consumer video rental outlets; non-tradable under both.

isic_name: Renting and leasing of other personal and household goods
rationale: Consumer/household-goods rental serving local users; non-tradable Atlas, mildly mixed regionally.

isic_name: Renting and leasing of other machinery, equipment and tangible goods
rationale: Plant/equipment rental (construction, industrial machinery) serves business clients across a region (tradable regional) but is not an exported service (non-tradable Atlas). Divergence; mixed.

isic_name: Leasing of intellectual property and similar products, except copyrighted works
rationale: Licensing of patents, trademarks and franchises generates royalties that flow across regions and borders; tradable under both. Mixed under Atlas given heterogeneity.

Recruitment/placement serves employers and job-seekers across a region/nation (tradable regional), but the core matching is largely a domestic labour-market service (non-tradable Atlas); mixed, some cross-border recruitment.
Temp/staffing agencies supply labour to client firms; agencies operate across a region (tradable regional) but supply is to the domestic market (non-tradable Atlas). Divergence; mixed.
HR/payroll/PEO provision can serve multi-province corporate clients (tradable regional) but is mostly not an exported service (non-tradable Atlas); mixed.
Travel agencies earn commissions serving travellers; inbound/tour bookings are part of exported tourism services; tradable under both.
Tour operators package and sell destination experiences to visitors from other regions and abroad -- a core exported tourism service; tradable under both.

isic_name: Other reservation service and related activities
rationale: Reservation/ticketing and related services support travel and tourism flows; tradable under both, mixed under Atlas given some local activity.
Guarding services are delivered at the client's local premises; mostly non-tradable, though firms can hold multi-province contracts -- mixed regionally.
Alarm monitoring/installation can run from a regional/national centre (straddles) but ultimately serves local premises; mixed under both, leaning local.
Private investigation serves mostly local/regional clients and can occasionally serve clients elsewhere; mixed, leaning non-tradable.
Integrated facilities management serves client sites locally, but contractors increasingly hold multi-province corporate contracts (tradable regional); non-tradable Atlas. Mixed.
Building cleaning is performed on-site for local clients -- a ubiquitous local service; non-tradable under both.

isic_name: Other building and industrial cleaning activities
rationale: Specialized/industrial cleaning is on-site but specialists can serve a regional industrial base; mostly non-tradable, mixed regionally.

isic_name: Landscape care and maintenance service activities
rationale: Gardening/landscaping performed on-site for local clients; non-tradable under both.
Outsourced office administration can serve clients across a region (mixed regional) but is largely a support service to local establishments (non-tradable Atlas).

isic_name: Photocopying, document preparation and other specialized office support activities
rationale: Walk-in document/office support for local clients; non-tradable Atlas, mildly mixed regionally.
Call/contact centres are classic business-process outsourcing serving clients in other regions and abroad -- internationally tradable; tradable under both.

isic_name: Organization of conventions and trade shows
rationale: Convention/trade-show organisers attract exhibitors and visitors from other regions and abroad (MICE tourism); tradable under both, mixed under Atlas for local events.

isic_name: Activities of collection agencies and credit bureaus
rationale: Debt-collection and credit-reference services can be centralised and serve clients across a region/nation (tradable regional); not typically exported (non-tradable Atlas). Mixed.
Contract packing/labelling supports manufacturers and exporters and can serve clients across a region (tradable regional); the service itself is not exported (non-tradable Atlas). Divergence; mixed.

isic_name: Other business support service activities n.e.c.
rationale: Heterogeneous catch-all of business support; some serve regional clients (tradable regional) but much is local administrative support (non-tradable Atlas). Low confidence/mixed.

Local schooling for resident children; non-tradable under both (anchor: primary/secondary excluded).
Secondary schooling serves the resident population locally; non-tradable under both.
Vocational/technical schools mostly serve local students, but some specialized institutes draw a regional catchment; non-tradable Atlas, mixed regionally.

Universities draw students from across the country (and some international students) -- strongly region-serving (tradable regional) and partly an exported service (mixed Atlas); routine teaching is local. Canonical Atlas-vs-regional divergence (anchor): non-tradable Atlas, tradable regional.
Driving schools and sports/recreation instruction mostly serve local learners; some academies draw regionally -- non-tradable, mixed.
Music/art/language tuition mostly serves local learners; specialized academies can draw regionally -- non-tradable, mixed.
Includes language schools, exam prep and online courses that can serve students elsewhere (tradable regional, partly Atlas), but much is local tuition; mixed/low confidence.
Educational consulting/support services can be delivered to institutions across a region/nation (tradable regional) but are not generally exported (non-tradable Atlas); mixed.

section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Referral and specialized hospitals draw patients from many provinces (tradable regional) and attract some medical tourism (mixed Atlas); routine hospital care is local. Canonical Atlas-vs-regional divergence (anchor): non-tradable Atlas, tradable regional.

section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Routine medical/dental practice serves local patients (non-tradable), but specialist consultants and dental/medical tourism draw a wider catchment; mixed under both, leaning local.

section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Diagnostic labs, imaging and ambulance services often operate from regional hubs serving multiple provinces (tradable regional) but are not generally exported (non-tradable Atlas); mixed.

section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Residential nursing care mainly serves the local/regional population; some specialized facilities draw a wider catchment -- non-tradable, mixed regionally.

isic_name: Residential care activities for mental retardation, mental health and substance abuse
section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Specialized residential mental-health/substance-abuse care can serve a regional catchment but is largely place-bound social care; non-tradable, mixed regionally.

isic_name: Residential care activities for the elderly and disabled
section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Care homes serve mostly local/regional residents; non-tradable Atlas, mildly mixed regionally.

rationale: Residential social care, largely local/regional; non-tradable, mixed regionally.

isic_name: Social work activities without accommodation for the elderly and disabled

rationale: Community social services for local residents; non-tradable under both.

isic_name: Other social work activities without accommodation
section_name: Human health and social work activities
rationale: Local community/social assistance services; non-tradable under both.

Public libraries/archives serve the local resident population; non-tradable under both.

isic_name: Museums activities and operation of historical sites and buildings
rationale: Museums and heritage sites attract visitors from other regions and abroad (cultural tourism); tradable under both, mixed under Atlas for small local museums.

isic_name: Botanical and zoological gardens and nature reserves activities
rationale: Gardens, zoos and nature reserves are tourism draws pulling visitors from elsewhere (highly relevant for Ecuador); tradable under both, mixed under Atlas where attendance is local.
Casinos/betting draw patrons from a regional catchment and tourists (tradable regional), and online betting can cross borders (mixed Atlas); much play is local. Mixed; leans regional-tradable.
Sports facilities mostly serve local users, but stadiums hosting regional/national events draw wider audiences -- non-tradable, mixed regionally.

Mostly local sports provision (instructors, leagues); some professional/event activity draws wider audiences -- non-tradable, mixed.

isic_name: Activities of amusement parks and theme parks
rationale: Amusement/theme parks attract visitors travelling from other regions (and tourists); tradable under both, mixed under Atlas where attendance is mostly local.

isic_name: Other amusement and recreation activities n.e.c.
rationale: Mostly local recreation services; some attractions draw a regional/tourist catchment -- non-tradable, mixed.
